info.name: FoodManagement - Restaurant Management
info.description: FoodManagement Restaurant Management API regression + RBAC scenarios. Select FoodManagement-USER or FoodManagement-ADMIN as the active Postman environment. Both environments use the same {{TOKEN}} variable; the selected environment also exposes {{role}} as USER or ADMIN.

item.name: Get Restaurant Items - Restaurant Not Found
Bulk Add Items - Restaurant Not Found
03 - Restaurant RBAC
item.description: Role-aware RBAC regression. Use the active environment to switch credentials: FoodManagement-USER sends a USER JWT and FoodManagement-ADMIN sends an ADMIN JWT through the shared {{TOKEN}} variable. Write requests expect 403 for USER and their normal 2xx success code for ADMIN.

item.name: RBAC - GET restaurants - USER or ADMIN - 200

exec: const role=(pm.environment.get('role')||'').toUpperCase(); pm.test('Active role is USER or ADMIN',()=>pm.expect(['USER','ADMIN']).to.include(role));

const restaurants=pm.response.json(); if(!pm.environment.get('restaurantId') && Array.isArray(restaurants) && restaurants.length>0 && restaurants[0].Id!==undefined) pm.environment.set('restaurantId',restaurants[0].Id);
const role=(pm.environment.get('role')||'').toUpperCase(); pm.test('Active role is USER or ADMIN',()=>pm.expect(['USER','ADMIN']).to.include(role));
const role=(pm.environment.get('role')||'').toUpperCase(); pm.test('Active role is USER or ADMIN',()=>pm.expect(['USER','ADMIN']).to.include(role));
